summary: Gullmouth is a multiplayer hide-and-seek horror game in a foggy cannery town and its storm drains. world.config.yaml and scripts/ui.js provide the multiplayer entry and responsive HUD; places/main/sim.js owns round truth, while player and bot behaviors run the hunt using shared rules, prop templates, sounds, and geometry generators.
places: places/main - Gullmouth's yard, docks, Saltgate bluff town, and underground drains; config.yaml binds terrain, atmosphere, look, and decorative layers across three scene cells.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - central yard, cannery, pier, cage, loot/decoys, hiding spots, and drain mouth.
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene - Saltgate cottages, secret-panel cottage, drain runs/grates, loot, lights, and hiding spots.
places/main/cells/x-1z1.scene - Saltgate chapel, door, hide tarp, and northern drain loot/stair area.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry, arrival behavior, action/gamepad bindings, player/camera templates, and scripts/ui.js renderer; UI referenceHeight is 1080.
sim.js - world-scope cadence/tick entry, separate from places/main/sim.js round referee.
places/main/sim.js - referee for lobby/hide/hunt/end, role draw, round entities, deaths, outcomes, and room-board publishing.
templates/player.js#player and templates/camera.js#camera - player body composition and custom orbit camera roots.
places/main/config.yaml - arena terrain, night lighting/atmosphere, scripts/look-default.js post-process, and decorative layers.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - authored central yard and dockyard structures, props, cage, and hiding spots.
shared: scripts/lib/data/rules.yml - round, role, combat, recipes, doors, noise, bots, powers, and creative-kit tunables consumed by referee/player/bots.
scripts/lib/data/dream.yml and characters.yml - dream dialogue/clue data and shared character identity/model data for player selection and NPC looks.
scripts/lib/sfx.js - named sound registry reused by player, referee, bot, NPC, and door behaviors.
scripts/lib/noise.js - spawns short-lived tagged sound pings; bot-mimic.js reads fresh pings to investigate.
scripts/gen/kit.js - geometry/material primitives reused by scene-prop, building, and door generators.
templates/props.js - shared FORMS and loot, decoy, disguise, trap, bait, lure, tripwire, barricade, smoke, and snare definitions; tags/state distinguish roles.
templates/dream.js#FAKE_NAMES and #fishermanForm - borrowed dreamer/fisherman presentation and names for mimic disguises; dreamer and clue templates also live here.
scripts/look-default.js - place-bound cinematic post-process grades the scene and adds vignette/grain; high/ultra tiers ray-march mist with lighting and wind.
notableExports: places/main/sim.js and sim.js - export cadence, tick.
scripts/player.js - exports onInput, popScarecrow, update; scripts/bot-mimic.js and scripts/bot-hider.js - export updateSchedule, update.
scripts/door.js - exports ears, update; scripts/lib/noise.js - exports noise; scripts/lib/sfx.js - exports SFX.
scripts/dreamer.js - exports updateSchedule, update; scripts/clue.js - exports update.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - exports sit, onInput, update; scripts/camera.js - exports onInput, update.
scripts/arrival.js - exports onArrive, onLeave; scripts/ui.js - exports pick, play, join, fresh, openMenu, showTutorial, closeTutorial, default; ui/nametag.js - exports default.

scripts/look-default.js - exports look; scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - exports heightAt, materialAt; scripts/gen/kit.js - exports geometry helpers and scene generators export geometry, usually collider.
templates/dream.js - exports dreamer, clue, fishermanForm, FAKE_NAMES; templates/creature.js exports mimicBody; templates/props.js exports FORMS and gameplay props.
ownership: places/main/sim.js - ctx.place.state phase/timers, original mimicIds and draw/name, winner/feed/objectives/blackout; assigns/reset roles, spawns/removes NPC hiders, judges traps and kit snares/wires, resolves deaths/outcomes, and publishes room board.

scripts/player.js - each player's role actions, hp/inventory/disguise/reveal/ambush/claw lock, powers/cooldowns, stolen face/name, smoke membership, prompts/conversation/hiding, stun/root, and menu/character state.
scripts/door.js - each door's open/broken/barred/hp/swing state; handles press events and synchronized leaf animation.
scripts/bot-mimic.js - bot hunt mode/target, disguise, food powers, fake loot, attacks, and reactions to smoke/scarecrows; scripts/bot-hider.js - NPC hider mode/goal/hiddenIn and survival behavior.
scripts/dreamer.js - NPC wandering/talker-facing/murmur, warning line/cooldown, and mimic detection; emits scream/shake.

scripts/ui.js - presentation only: reads phase/results/feed, room list, viewer role/health/inventory/prompt/powers/tricks, smoke and stolen-face state, and renders HUD/menu; scripts/look-default.js owns no gameplay state.
Placed loot, traps, kit props, dream clues, and hiding spots own their refill/interaction/occupant state; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js owns avatar movement/animation/facing.
ui/nametag.js - derives other-player tags from body role, reveal/fade/smoke/disguise, stolen face name, and distance; it does not own gameplay state.
flows: places/main/sim.js tick → writes place phase/endsAt and player roles → scripts/player.js and bot behaviors gate actions; scripts/ui.js renders phase/results.
places/main/sim.js round start → reads dream.yml and spawns dreamers/clues/food → dreamer.js and clue.js update them; player.js interacts and referee tracks objectives.
scripts/player.js hider interact → claims clue or starts/judges dreamer conversation → changes clue/NPC state → referee counts genuine clues and woken dreamers.
scripts/player.js attacks/crafts → damages actors or spawns traps, bait, lure, flash, and kit props → places/main/sim.js judges traps/kit and resolves deaths/win.
Human mimics start hidden among hiders with a hunt-start claw lock; player actions, traps, and referee reveal state → UI and ui/nametag.js suppress or display identity accordingly.
places/main/sim.js solo round → spawns mimic bot and opens cage after hideSeconds; human-mimic rounds start directly in hunt; bot-mimic.js hunts players/NPC hiders.
places/main/sim.js fills available seats with tagged NPC hiders → bot-hider.js roams, hides, and rummages; late joiners take over a living NPC position/wounds or become ghosts when none is available.
player, bot-hider, door, and lure sounds → scripts/lib/noise.js creates ping rows → bot-mimic.js reads fresh in-range pings and investigates.
scripts/player.js E/R or mimic claw → emits press {by, act} to a door → scripts/door.js toggles, bars, or breaks it and animates its shared leaf; door sounds also emit noise.
Player hider kit spawns tripwire/barricade/smoke/scarecrow; places/main/sim.js judges tripwire and mimic snare overlaps, while bot-mimic.js can be diverted by scarecrows and loses smoked hiders.
Mimic B/H/J actions in scripts/player.js → play echo, place referee-judged gut snare, or copy nearby hider face/name → player and ui/nametag.js use face state until reveal/round reset.

world.config.yaml actions → scripts/player.js handles menu/game actions and scripts/ui.js renders; arrival.js handles fresh/menu arrivals, while referee publishes and reads room-scoped SQL lobby rows.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/kit.js and scripts/gen/{boatshed,cannery,office,warehouse,cottage}.js - shared geometry kit builds walk-in structures; scene placements/params vary footprints, openings, materials, and detail.

scripts/gen/{boat,dinghy,crane,container,drums,drain,dumpster,fence,fish-crates,forklift,lamp-post,net-rack,pallets,pier,puddles,tarp,tyres,locker,fishpile}.js - dock, yard, drain, and hiding-place generators reused with placement/params varying location and form.
scripts/gen/door.js with templates/door.js - shared hinged leaves and sliding secret panels; scene state varies kind, hinge/yaw, swing, and slide.
templates/props.js#FORMS - crate, barrel, and loot silhouettes reused for real loot, decoys, and mimic disguises; tags, physics, and state distinguish gameplay.
templates/dream.js#dreamer and #fishermanForm - mimic fisherman borrows dreamer model/UI and names; human/bot implementations vary disguise and animation handling.
scripts/grass.js, scripts/pebble.js, scripts/reed.js - terrain decoration geometries bound in places/main/config.yaml; grass uses scripts/grass-look.js for material.
scripts/flicker.js and scripts/lamp-flicker.js - independent light behaviors: irregular bulb stutter versus burst-and-rest sodium lamp flicker.
scripts/lib/data/characters.yml entries - shared selected character data drives player menu/avatar and NPC hider looks.
migrationNotes: Round truth and win adjudication belong to places/main/sim.js in ctx.place.state; root sim.js is a separate world tick. Human mimics start in the hider ring with a claw lock; solo bot rounds retain the caged hide phase.
s.mimicIds records original seeker(s); risen mimics do not substitute for them in original-seeker survival checks. NPC hiders count alive until dead or taken over by a joining player.

Door state lives on each tagged door: press is routed with {by, act}; timers use milliseconds, hp is counted, broken doors stay open during the round, and clearRound resets doors and round-spawned tagged kit.

Fresh arrival opens the menu; player.js marks menu-initiated room crosses with state.joining, and the referee excludes menu players from role draw. SQL lobby rows are room-scoped and freshness-limited.

Game timestamps are milliseconds (ctx.now() + seconds * 1000); dream convince period values are milliseconds, while rules durations/cooldowns are seconds. Preserve player.state.avatarModel as the own-character fallback.

Saltgate/drain coordinates extend west to x=-120: terrain, config holes, fence runs, and scene cells must align; scripts/gen/drain.js is world-coordinate geometry placed at origin, with terrain roofed by the y=4 bluff.
